boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain United States Air Force Academy
boards.description: Ten documented late-hour food destinations in the north Colorado Springs area, selected for current published availability and under-21 access.

cards.title: McDonald's on West Baptist Road
cards.subtitle: 765 West Baptist Road, Colorado Springs, CO 80921
cards.notes: Use the location page to confirm services before leaving; its published restaurant and drive-thru schedules list 24-hour operation every day.
cards.short_summary: A documented all-night option in the 80921 area.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists both restaurant/lobby and drive-thru hours as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday at 765 West Baptist Road.
cards.source_title: McDonald's — 765 West Baptist Road, Colorado Springs
cards.access_notes: Published restaurant/lobby and drive-thru hours are 24 hours daily; verify holiday changes directly with the location.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Interquest Parkway
cards.subtitle: 1208 Interquest Parkway, Colorado Springs, CO 80921
cards.notes: Plan for the drive-thru if arriving after the dining room closes; the location publishes drive-thru service until 2 or 3 a.m.
cards.short_summary: Interquest food stop with later drive-thru than dining-room hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Sunday through Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday at 1208 Interquest Parkway.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1208 Interquest Parkway
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until 2 a.m. Sun–Wed and 3 a.m. Thu–Sat; dine-in has earlier closing hours.

cards.title: Shake Shack Interquest
cards.subtitle: 9723 Federal Drive, Colorado Springs, CO 80921
cards.notes: Check the day before making the trip: the official location schedule keeps the restaurant open through midnight on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A weekend midnight option at Interquest.
cards.evidence_claim: Shake Shack lists midnight closing on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday for its Interquest location.
cards.source_title: Shake Shack — Interquest, Colorado Springs
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until midnight Fri–Sun and until 11 p.m. Mon–Thu.

cards.title: Whataburger on Interquest Parkway
cards.subtitle: 1310 Interquest Parkway, Colorado Springs, CO 80921
cards.notes: For a late pickup, use the published drive-thru schedule rather than assuming the dining room is open; drive-thru service is listed around the clock.
cards.short_summary: Interquest location with an all-day drive-thru schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists 24-hour drive-thru and delivery service daily at 1310 Interquest Parkway; dine-in hours are more limited on most days.
cards.source_title: Whataburger — 1310 Interquest Parkway
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru and delivery are published as 24 hours daily; dine-in is generally 6 a.m.–10 p.m. except Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: IHOP on North Chestnut Street
cards.subtitle: 3090 N. Chestnut Street, Colorado Springs, CO 80907
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, takeout, or online ordering according to the current location page, which lists the restaurant as open 24 hours every day.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour sit-down breakfast-and-diner option.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its 3090 N. Chestnut Street restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday and identifies it as offering late-night food.
cards.source_title: IHOP — 3090 N. Chestnut Street, Colorado Springs
cards.access_notes: The official location page publishes 24-hour restaurant hours every day.

cards.entity_name: Carl's Jr., 425 Garden of the Gods
cards.title: Carl's Jr. at Garden of the Gods
cards.subtitle: 425 Garden of the Gods, Colorado Springs, CO 80907
cards.notes: Use this as a drive-thru or dine-in stop only after checking the location page; its weekly hours table currently lists every day as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A documented 24-hour Carl's Jr. location.
cards.evidence_claim: Carl's Jr. lists the 425 Garden of the Gods location as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Carl's Jr. — 425 Garden of the Gods
cards.access_notes: Published hours are open 24 hours daily; breakfast service has separate timing.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box, 3690 New Center Point Boulevard
cards.title: Jack in the Box at New Center Point
cards.subtitle: 3690 New Center Point Boulevard, Colorado Springs, CO 80922
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru schedule for a later run: the official page lists service through 11:30 p.m., while lobby hours end earlier.
cards.short_summary: A late drive-thru option east of the Academy area.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists drive-thru hours at 3690 New Center Point Boulevard until 11:30 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 3690 New Center Point Boulevard
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru hours run until 11:30 p.m.; the lobby closes earlier, so check the day-specific schedule.

cards.title: Wendy's on Montebello Drive West
cards.subtitle: 2515 Montebello Drive West, Colorado Springs, CO 80918
cards.notes: For a Friday or Saturday late stop, the official page lists both restaurant and drive-thru service through midnight; other nights close earlier.
cards.short_summary: A documented weekend-midnight option near North Academy Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until midnight on Friday and Saturday at 2515 Montebello Drive West.
cards.source_title: Wendy's — 2515 Montebello Drive West
cards.access_notes: Published Friday and Saturday restaurant and drive-thru hours end at midnight; Sunday through Thursday hours vary.

cards.title: Whataburger on Montebello
cards.subtitle: 2550 Montebello, Colorado Springs, CO 80918
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when arriving late on a weekday; the location page lists it as 24 hours daily and shows later dine-in only on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A separate Montebello location with round-the-clock drive-thru access.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists 24-hour drive-thru and delivery every day at 2550 Montebello, with 24-hour dine-in on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Whataburger — 2550 Montebello
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru and delivery are published as 24 hours daily; dine-in is 24 hours Friday and Saturday and ends at 10 p.m. on other days.

cards.title: Wendy's on Stetson Hills Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 5850 Stetson Hills Boulevard, Colorado Springs, CO 80923
cards.notes: Aim for Thursday through Saturday if planning a midnight visit; the published restaurant and drive-thru schedules list those nights until 12 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Stetson Hills option with midnight hours on selected nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until midnight Thursday through Saturday at 5850 Stetson Hills Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Wendy's — 5850 Stetson Hills Boulevard
cards.access_notes: Published Thursday–Saturday restaurant and drive-thru hours end at midnight; other nights are listed through 11 p.m.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: A practical look at named cadet-area places used for studying, meals, activities, performances, and daily formations.

cards.title: McDermott Library
cards.subtitle: Cadet Area research and reading library
cards.notes: Use its reference, research, and reading collections for coursework; cadet, faculty, and staff access is restricted, so arrange an escort if eligible.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated academic library with research collections and special collections.
cards.evidence_claim: McDermott Library is in the cadet area and provides reference, research, and reading collections; access is restricted to Academy cadets, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: McDermott Library | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Restricted to Academy cadets, faculty, and staff; escorted visits may be arranged through Administrative Offices.

cards.title: Arnold Hall
cards.subtitle: Cadet Wing social center
cards.notes: Check the theater, ballroom, displays, lounges, and recreation areas when base access permits; it is a useful indoor meeting point near the Cadet Area.
cards.short_summary: A multipurpose social and event building west of the Cadet Area.
cards.evidence_claim: Arnold Hall is the social center for the cadet wing and contains a theater, ballroom, food court, coffee shop, meeting rooms, and recreation facilities.
cards.source_title: Arnold Hall | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Open to the public except under base restrictions.

cards.title: Richter Lounge Food Court
cards.subtitle: Inside Arnold Hall
cards.notes: Meet at a table for a coffee, snack, or conversation, then check the monitors for campus information; food and drinks require a purchase.
cards.short_summary: Arnold Hall’s food-court lounge offers tables and large-screen monitors.
cards.evidence_claim: Richter Lounge Food Court has food options, tables, and large-screen monitors, and the Academy describes it as a place for conversation, coffee, or lunch.
cards.source_title: Arnold Hall | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Located north of the Arnold Hall Theater; the official page says it is available to the public subject to base restrictions.

cards.title: Mitchell Hall
cards.subtitle: Cadet dining facility
cards.notes: Plan around the cadet meal schedule: weekday breakfast and noon meals are required during the academic year, with buffet meals at other times.
cards.short_summary: The Academy’s principal cadet dining facility and shared meal setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Mitchell Hall is the cadet dining hall, where more than 4,000 cadets assemble for family-style noon meals during the academic year.
cards.source_title: Day in the Life | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Cadet dining facility; visitor access and meal availability should be confirmed with the Academy.

cards.title: Fairchild Hall
cards.subtitle: Academic building in the Cadet Area
cards.notes: Use the Falcon Center between classes for a meal or a meetup, and keep the academic schedule in mind because most classes and labs are located here.
cards.short_summary: A central academic building with casual on-base dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: Most Academy academic classes and labs are located in Fairchild Hall, and the Falcon Center is presented as a place to meet friends for lunch between classes.
cards.source_title: Dormitories & Dining | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Located in the Cadet Area; follow base and building access rules.

cards.title: The Terrazzo
cards.subtitle: Cadet Area parade and circulation space
cards.notes: Watch the noon meal formation from the Honor Court wall, then follow the Cadet Wing’s route across the Terrazzo toward Mitchell Hall.
cards.short_summary: The shared outdoor space crossed during the daily noon meal formation.
cards.evidence_claim: At 1130, the Cadet Wing lines up by squadron in front of Vandenberg Hall and marches across The Terrazzo to Mitchell Hall for lunch.
cards.source_title: Day in the Life | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Viewable from the Honor Court wall for Academy visitors; follow posted base access rules.

cards.title: Honor Court
cards.subtitle: Overlooking the Terrazzo
cards.notes: Use the Honor Court wall as the designated visitor vantage point for observing the Cadet Wing’s noon meal formation across the Terrazzo.
cards.short_summary: A named viewing point for a daily Academy formation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says visitors can watch noon meal formation from the Honor Court wall overlooking the Terrazzo.
cards.source_title: Day in the Life | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Follow visitor and base-access rules when viewing the formation.

cards.title: U.S. Air Force Academy Planetarium
cards.subtitle: 2120 Cadet Drive
cards.notes: Arrive early for a first-come, first-served public show; no ticket or reservation is required, but weather or cadet education can cancel a show.
cards.short_summary: A 110-seat digital dome used for cadet education and community shows.
cards.evidence_claim: The Planetarium offers free public shows on a first-come, first-served basis, with no tickets or reservations required.
cards.source_title: Self-Guided Tour | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Closed weekends, graduation day, and federal holidays; shows may be cancelled without notice for weather or cadet education.

cards.title: Cadet Field House
cards.subtitle: 2169 Field House Drive
cards.notes: Check the athletics schedule or event entry rules before going; the building groups an indoor track, basketball arena, and ice rink in one named facility.
cards.short_summary: A large multipurpose athletics building serving intercollegiate and intramural activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cadet Field House houses the indoor track, basketball arena, and ice hockey rink and supports numerous intercollegiate, practice, and intramural uses.
cards.source_title: Parents' Weekend | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Entry policies apply for events; people and belongings entering the venue may be subject to search.

cards.title: Core Values Ramp
cards.subtitle: Between Vandenberg Hall and Fairchild Hall
cards.notes: Pause at the ramp while walking the Cadet Area: it is the route new cadets ascend on in-processing day as their Academy transition begins.
cards.short_summary: A named Cadet Area ramp associated with the first day for new cadets.
cards.evidence_claim: The Core Values Ramp leads from the main Terrazzo toward the parade field, and new cadets ascend it on in-processing day to begin their Academy transition.
cards.source_title: Cadet Wing Parade | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Located between Vandenberg Hall and Fairchild Hall; respect Cadet Area access controls and active formations.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten free, under-21-safe outdoor and visitor-center stops at Garden of the Gods, a city park near the Academy.

cards.entity_name: Garden of the Gods Visitor & Nature Center
cards.title: Browse the Visitor & Nature Center
cards.subtitle: Garden of the Gods Park, Colorado Springs
cards.notes: Meet up at the official gateway, browse the interactive exhibits, then choose a trail or rock formation to explore together.
cards.short_summary: A no-ticket indoor starting point for a park hang.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Colorado Springs states that the Garden of the Gods Visitor & Nature Center is free and that the park can be enjoyed free of charge.
cards.source_title: Garden of the Gods | City of Colorado Springs
cards.access_notes: The official city page identifies the Visitor & Nature Center as free; verify current opening information before travel.

cards.title: Walk to Gateway Rock
cards.subtitle: Garden of the Gods Park, Colorado Springs
cards.notes: Use the park’s main paths for a group walk to Gateway Rock, pausing to compare views and take photos from established areas.
cards.short_summary: An easy landmark-focused walk inside the free city park.
cards.evidence_claim: Gateway Rock is a named formation in Garden of the Gods Park, which the City of Colorado Springs says can be enjoyed free of charge.
cards.source_title: Garden of the Gods | City of Colorado Springs
cards.access_notes: Stay on official paths and observe posted park rules; the city states park admission is free.

cards.title: Photo stop at Balanced Rock
cards.subtitle: Garden of the Gods Park, Colorado Springs
cards.notes: Bring friends for a quick photo stop at Balanced Rock, using the designated parking and established viewing areas around the formation.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable formation for a simple outdoor meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: Balanced Rock is a named Garden of the Gods attraction; the City of Colorado Springs states that the park can be enjoyed free of charge.
cards.source_title: Garden of the Gods | City of Colorado Springs
cards.access_notes: The city page lists Balanced Rock among park photography locations and says the park is free to enjoy.

cards.title: Hike toward Siamese Twins
cards.subtitle: Garden of the Gods Park, Colorado Springs
cards.notes: Choose the Siamese Twins Trail for a shared walk and a framed Pikes Peak view; keep the group on the marked route.
cards.short_summary: A named trail destination for a no-cost group hike.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Colorado Springs identifies Siamese Twins Trail as a Garden of the Gods route and says the park can be enjoyed free of charge.
cards.source_title: Garden of the Gods | City of Colorado Springs
cards.access_notes: Use established trails and plan within posted park hours; the city states admission is free.

cards.title: Find the Three Graces
cards.subtitle: Garden of the Gods Park, Colorado Springs
cards.notes: Make the Three Graces a shared landmark goal on a daylight walk, using official trails and respecting all signs around rock formations.
cards.short_summary: A named formation that gives a casual walk a destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Three Graces is a named formation shown on the City of Colorado Springs Garden of the Gods map; the city says the park is free to enjoy.
cards.source_title: Garden of the Gods Park Map | City of Colorado Springs
cards.access_notes: This landmark is within Garden of the Gods Park; the city’s park page states the park can be enjoyed free of charge.

cards.title: View Cathedral Spires
cards.subtitle: Garden of the Gods Park, Colorado Springs
cards.notes: Use the mapped trail network for a daylight walk with Cathedral Spires as the visual checkpoint, without leaving established paths.
cards.short_summary: A named sandstone landmark for a free outdoor stroll.
cards.evidence_claim: Cathedral Spires is named on the City of Colorado Springs Garden of the Gods map; the city says the park can be enjoyed free of charge.
cards.source_title: Garden of the Gods Park Map | City of Colorado Springs
cards.access_notes: Plan around park conditions and posted rules; city information states Garden of the Gods has free admission.

cards.title: Spot Kissing Camels
cards.subtitle: Garden of the Gods Park, Colorado Springs
cards.notes: Pick a legal overlook or trail view and see if everyone can identify the Kissing Camels silhouette before continuing the walk.
cards.short_summary: A named visual landmark for a low-key group challenge.
cards.evidence_claim: Kissing Camels is named on the City of Colorado Springs Garden of the Gods map; the city says the park can be enjoyed free of charge.
cards.source_title: Garden of the Gods Park Map | City of Colorado Springs
cards.access_notes: View from established public areas and follow park rules; the city states the park is free to enjoy.

cards.title: Pause at High Point Overlook
cards.subtitle: Garden of the Gods Park, Colorado Springs
cards.notes: Gather at the marked High Point Overlook for a short scenic pause, conversation, and photos before following a nearby official trail.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed overlook for a free, brief meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: High Point Overlook is identified on the City of Colorado Springs Garden of the Gods map; the city says the park can be enjoyed free of charge.
cards.source_title: Garden of the Gods Park Map | City of Colorado Springs
cards.access_notes: Use the official parking and overlook area; city information states there is no admission charge for the park.

cards.title: Stroll Perkins Central Garden Trail
cards.subtitle: Garden of the Gods Park, Colorado Springs
cards.notes: Set an unhurried group pace on the paved Perkins Central Garden Trail and use the formations along the route as conversation stops.
cards.short_summary: A paved, formation-filled walk with no ticket needed.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins Central Garden Trail is named on the City of Colorado Springs Garden of the Gods map, and the city says the park can be enjoyed free of charge.
cards.source_title: Garden of the Gods Park Map | City of Colorado Springs
cards.access_notes: Use the mapped paved trail and follow posted rules; the City of Colorado Springs describes park access as free.

cards.title: Start at Spring Canyon Trailhead
cards.subtitle: Garden of the Gods Park, Colorado Springs
cards.notes: Meet at Spring Canyon Trailhead, agree on a turnaround point, and take a daylight walk on the park’s mapped trail system together.
cards.short_summary: A named trailhead for planning a flexible free walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Spring Canyon Trailhead is shown on the City of Colorado Springs Garden of the Gods map; the city says the park can be enjoyed free of charge.
cards.source_title: Garden of the Gods Park Map | City of Colorado Springs
cards.access_notes: Remain on official trails and check conditions; the City of Colorado Springs states the park is free to enjoy.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented cadet study environments spanning library research, academic support, collaborative rooms, and residence-hall desks.

cards.title: McDermott Library’s collaborative third floor
cards.subtitle: Fairchild Hall, cadet area
cards.notes: Set up with a partner or spread out solo among the third floor’s collaborative seating, individual work areas, Wi-Fi, and high-tech workspaces.
cards.short_summary: A large library floor configured for both collaborative and individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: The renovated third floor includes space for 300 cadets, individual study areas, Wi-Fi, 48 high-tech workspaces, couches, and chairs.
cards.source_title: McDermott Library renovations give cadets’ more study space
cards.access_notes: McDermott Library is in the cadet area and has limited access; confirm eligibility before going.

cards.title: Research beside primary-source aviation history
cards.subtitle: Sixth floor, McDermott Library
cards.notes: Plan a source-based work session around the sixth-floor collections on manned flight, air warfare, falconry, and U.S. Air Force history.
cards.short_summary: A sixth-floor special-collections setting for focused historical research.
cards.evidence_claim: Clark Special Collections is on McDermott Library’s sixth floor and holds historical materials on manned flight, air warfare, falconry, and the U.S. Air Force.
cards.source_title: McDermott Library
cards.access_notes: Located within McDermott Library in the limited-access cadet area; verify collection-use procedures with library staff.

cards.title: Academic Success Center’s support hub
cards.subtitle: First floor, northwest corner of Fairchild Hall
cards.notes: Use the centralized center when you want faculty-led help with study strategies, communication, or quantitative coursework in one stop.
cards.short_summary: A Fairchild Hall learning center combining academic-support programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academic Success Center provides faculty-led personalized instruction and is located on Fairchild Hall’s first floor in the northwest corner.
cards.source_title: Academic Success Center
cards.access_notes: ASC lists Monday–Friday 7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. hours; its named centers have Monday–Thursday evening hours.

cards.title: Quantitative Reasoning Center for STEM problem sets
cards.subtitle: Academic Success Center, Fairchild Hall
cards.notes: Bring attempted calculus, physics, chemistry, or mechanical-engineering work and use individual extra instruction or a targeted small-group session.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated supplemental-instruction setting for core quantitative disciplines.
cards.evidence_claim: The QRC offers one-on-one extra instruction, small-group sessions, and workshops in STEM subjects including calculus, physics, chemistry, and mechanical engineering.
cards.source_title: Quantitative Reasoning Center
cards.access_notes: The QRC operates Monday–Thursday, 4:00–8:30 p.m.; cadets should bring an honest attempt at assigned problems for extra instruction.

cards.title: Writing Center for draft-focused work
cards.subtitle: Academic Success Center, Fairchild Hall
cards.notes: Take a paper or report draft to the Writing Center and use the Academic Success Center’s communication-support setting to refine it.
cards.short_summary: A named Academic Success Center resource for written communication.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academic Success Center’s Communication Strategies Center includes the Writing Center, and the Academy describes it as helping cadets with papers and reports for all classes.
cards.source_title: Academic Success Center
cards.access_notes: The ASC offers evening hours for the Writing Center Monday–Thursday from 4:00–8:30 p.m.

cards.title: Public Speaking Lab for presentation rehearsal
cards.subtitle: Academic Success Center, Fairchild Hall
cards.notes: Use this dedicated lab when preparing a course presentation and you want a setting designed around speaking and delivery practice.
cards.short_summary: A communication-support space for preparing spoken presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Public Speaking Lab is one of the Academic Success Center’s Communication Strategies Center resources and is identified as support for cadets’ speaking presentations.
cards.source_title: Academic Success Center
cards.access_notes: The ASC offers evening hours for the Public Speaking Lab Monday–Thursday from 4:00–8:30 p.m.

cards.title: Polaris Hall collaboration rooms
cards.subtitle: Center for Character and Leadership Development
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a small project group or an individual workstation; each setup supports device connection, power, network access, and displays.
cards.short_summary: Technology-equipped small-group rooms in Polaris Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Polaris Hall has 10 collaboration rooms with screens, power outlets, Ethernet, HDMI, Wi-Fi, and LAN connections; the reservation form identifies them for small working groups or individuals.
cards.source_title: Polaris Hall Reservation Request Form
cards.access_notes: Reservation form lists operating hours of 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Monday–Friday, closed weekends and federal holidays; reserve through CCLD.

cards.title: Polaris Hall’s East and West seminar rooms
cards.subtitle: Center for Character and Leadership Development
cards.notes: Book a seminar room for a structured project session when a large display, whiteboard, Wi-Fi, and table seating will help the group work.
cards.short_summary: Two presentation-equipped rooms suited to medium-sized academic groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Polaris Hall has East and West seminar rooms with table seating, a projector, large screen, in-floor power and Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and whiteboard.
cards.source_title: Polaris Hall Reservation Request Form
cards.access_notes: Advance booking is required; the form lists 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Monday–Friday operation and closure on weekends and federal holidays.

cards.title: Vandenberg Hall desk setup
cards.subtitle: Cadet residence hall
cards.notes: Use the desk in your assigned room for a contained individual session, with nearby squadron resources available within the residence-hall setting.
cards.short_summary: A cadet residence hall where assigned rooms include desks.
cards.evidence_claim: Vandenberg Hall contains 1,320 cadet rooms, and the Academy states that cadet rooms typically provide each cadet with a desk.
cards.source_title: Cadet Life
cards.access_notes: Residence-hall rooms are assigned to cadets; this is not a public study location.

cards.title: Sijan Hall desk setup
cards.subtitle: Cadet residence hall
cards.notes: Use the desk in your assigned room for an individual study block, then keep materials compact in the shared cadet-room layout.
cards.short_summary: A second cadet residence hall whose rooms include desks.
cards.evidence_claim: Sijan Hall houses cadets in assigned rooms, and the Academy states that cadet rooms typically provide each cadet with a desk.
cards.source_title: Cadet Life
cards.access_notes: Residence-hall rooms are assigned to cadets; this is not a public study location.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten public-facing destinations in the Academy’s northern El Paso County and Colorado Springs orbit, each anchored to its named road or corridor.

cards.title: Working mining-history exhibits
cards.subtitle: North Gate Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use the museum’s North Gate Boulevard address to plan a visit focused on Colorado and American West mining, ranching, and industry history.
cards.short_summary: A museum stop for interpreting regional industrial history.
cards.evidence_claim: WMMI states that its mission is to educate the public about the history and continuing contributions of mining, ranching, and supporting industries in the American West; it lists 225 North Gate Blvd.
cards.source_title: Western Museum of Mining & Industry — Mission and History
cards.access_notes: The official site lists the museum at 225 North Gate Blvd; purchase tickets through the museum before visiting.

cards.title: Four miles of multi-use trails
cards.subtitle: Stella Drive corridor
cards.notes: Enter from Stella Drive and choose a multi-use trail route; the county also lists picnic areas, a playground, fields, and interpretive displays.
cards.short_summary: A county park with forest trails and active recreation amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: El Paso County lists Fox Run Regional Park at 2110 Stella Drive and describes four miles of multi-use trails, plus pavilions, playgrounds, a lake, and a climbing rock.
cards.source_title: El Paso County Parks — Fox Run Regional Park
cards.access_notes: County-posted park hours are 5 a.m.–9 p.m.; restroom availability varies seasonally.

cards.title: Play fields and forest paths
cards.subtitle: Shoup Road corridor
cards.notes: Approach via Shoup Road and use the developed park area for a walk, picnic, playground break, or court and field recreation.
cards.short_summary: A 385-acre county park combining forest setting with recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: El Paso County identifies Black Forest Regional Park at 4800 Shoup Road and lists hiking, cycling, horseback riding, picnic pavilions, playgrounds, fields, and tennis courts.
cards.source_title: El Paso County Parks — Black Forest Regional Park
cards.access_notes: County-posted park hours are 5 a.m.–9 p.m.; check conditions and facility availability before departure.

cards.title: Nine miles of single-track trail
cards.subtitle: Vollmer Road corridor
cards.notes: Start at the Vollmer Road trailhead and select a trail suited to your group; the site includes a large trailhead, restroom, and interpretive kiosk.
cards.short_summary: An open-space trailhead in the Black Forest landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: El Paso County lists Pineries Open Space at 13201 Vollmer Road and says Phase 1 includes a large trailhead, restroom, and approximately nine miles of single-track trail.
cards.source_title: El Paso County Parks — Pineries Open Space
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 5 a.m.–9 p.m. April–October and 6 a.m.–6 p.m. November–March.

cards.title: Non-motorized perimeter trail
cards.subtitle: Burgess Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the Burgess Road parking area for a non-motorized perimeter-trail outing; equestrians are among the permitted trail users noted by the county.
cards.short_summary: A 90-acre open-space stop with a multi-use perimeter trail.
cards.evidence_claim: El Paso County describes Black Forest – Section 16 as a 90-acre open space with a multi-use perimeter trail system for non-motorized users, and lists 8510 Burgess Road.
cards.source_title: El Paso County Parks — Black Forest Section 16
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are dawn to dusk; the county notes a restroom near the parking area is open year-round.

cards.title: Loop options from the regional trail
cards.subtitle: New Santa Fe Regional Trail corridor
cards.notes: Use the adjacent New Santa Fe Regional Trail connection to reach the open space, then follow posted loops and consult the information kiosks.
cards.short_summary: A foothills open space connected to the regional trail network.
cards.evidence_claim: El Paso County says Santa Fe Open Space was created to let users of the adjacent New Santa Fe Regional Trail experience a foothills setting; it lists hiking, cycling, horseback riding, kiosks, and restrooms.
cards.source_title: El Paso County Parks — Santa Fe Open Space
cards.access_notes: Follow posted trail and open-space guidance; use the county’s map link to identify the appropriate access point.

cards.title: Lake-side trailhead and walking path
cards.subtitle: County Line Road corridor
cards.notes: Begin on County Line Road and take the walking path around the lake’s south half or connect to the New Santa Fe Regional Trail.
cards.short_summary: A lake-side recreation area with a trail connection and picnic amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: El Paso County lists Palmer Lake Recreation Area at 199 County Line Road, with a walking path around the southern half of the lake and New Santa Fe Regional Trail access.
cards.source_title: El Paso County Parks — Palmer Lake Recreation Area
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are dawn to dusk. Fishing requires a valid Colorado fishing license; confirm lake conditions locally.

cards.title: Ten miles of multi-purpose trails
cards.subtitle: 21st Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the 21st Street access point for a trail or recreation stop; the county lists courts, fields, playgrounds, picnic areas, and an archery range.
cards.short_summary: A large regional park with trails and a broad mix of recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: El Paso County says Bear Creek Regional Park has ten miles of multi-purpose, non-motorized trails and lists access at 21st Street and West Rio Grande Avenue.
cards.source_title: El Paso County Parks — Bear Creek Regional Park
cards.access_notes: County-posted park hours are 5 a.m.–9 p.m. Bring your own equipment if using the archery range.

cards.title: Pikes Peak Greenway Trail access
cards.subtitle: West Cache La Poudre Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the Cache La Poudre Street access for paths and the Greenway connection, then choose from the park’s courts, ponds, playgrounds, and picnic spaces.
cards.short_summary: A city park with recreation amenities and a Greenway-trail connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Colorado Springs lists Monument Valley Park at 170 W. Cache La Poudre Street and identifies walking and biking paths plus access to the Pikes Peak Greenway Trail.
cards.source_title: City of Colorado Springs — Monument Valley Park
cards.access_notes: The city lists access points from the north end near Monroe Street and Wood Avenue to the south end near West Bijou Street and Sierra Madre Street.

cards.entity_name: Garden of the Gods Visitor & Nature Center
cards.title: Free exhibits and park orientation
cards.subtitle: North 30th Street at Gateway Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the visitor center to pick up a free trail map and orient to the park’s geology, ecology, history, and accessible visitor services.
cards.short_summary: The official gateway for maps, exhibits, and park information.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Colorado Springs identifies the Visitor & Nature Center at 1805 N. 30th Street at Gateway Road as a free visitor center with interactive exhibits and free park maps.
cards.source_title: City of Colorado Springs — Garden of the Gods
cards.access_notes: The city states the Visitor & Nature Center is free; park hours vary seasonally, from 5 a.m. to 9 or 10 p.m.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented milestones and recurring Academy practices that mark the cadet experience from arrival through leadership development.

cards.title: In-processing Day (I-Day)
cards.subtitle: Cadet entry tradition
cards.notes: Watch official Academy announcements for the annual in-processing schedule and public-attendance guidance before planning any visit to this military installation.
cards.short_summary: The Academy identifies I-Day as the first milestone in a cadet’s journey.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Air Force Academy lists In-processing as the first of its Academy milestones.
cards.source_title: The Milestones of the Academy
cards.access_notes: Base access and event access rules apply; check the Academy’s current visitor guidance.

cards.title: Basic Cadet Training
cards.subtitle: Cadet entry tradition
cards.notes: Use Academy-published information to understand this foundational six-week training phase; it is a formal cadet program, not a visitor activity.
cards.short_summary: Basic Cadet Training is an Academy-defined milestone before cadets join the Cadet Wing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy’s milestones page includes Basic Cadet Training, and its Acceptance Day page describes it as six weeks of mental, physical and military training.
cards.source_title: The Milestones of the Academy
cards.access_notes: This is an official cadet training program; it is not open for casual participation.

cards.title: Acceptance Day Parade
cards.subtitle: Stillman Parade Field milestone
cards.notes: If attending as a guest, confirm the current parade date and installation-entry requirements through Academy channels before traveling to Stillman Parade Field.
cards.short_summary: The parade formally welcomes basic cadets into the Cadet Wing.
cards.evidence_claim: Acceptance Day celebrates completion of Basic Cadet Training; freshmen receive fourth-class shoulder boards and are accepted into the Cadet Wing.
cards.source_title: Acceptance Day
cards.access_notes: The Academy states guests may observe the parade from Stillman Parade Field stands, subject to current base-access guidance.

cards.title: Squadron Shuffle
cards.subtitle: Cadet Wing milestone
cards.notes: Treat this as a cadet-life milestone rather than a public program; use Academy updates for context if it appears on a current event or parent schedule.
cards.short_summary: The Academy names Squadron Shuffle among the milestones that structure cadet life.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Air Force Academy includes Squadron Shuffle in its official milestones sequence.
cards.source_title: The Milestones of the Academy
cards.access_notes: Cadet schedules and installation access are controlled by the Academy.

cards.title: Parents’ Weekend
cards.subtitle: Family connection milestone
cards.notes: Check the Academy’s current parent information before making plans, since program details, access procedures, and guest instructions can change each year.
cards.short_summary: The annual weekend reconnects cadets and families after Basic Cadet Training.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says Parents’ Weekend occurs every year over Labor Day weekend and lets cadets connect with families for the first time after Basic Cadet Training.
cards.source_title: Freshman Year
cards.access_notes: Consult current Academy parent and visitor guidance for attendance and base-entry details.

cards.title: Exemplar Dinner
cards.subtitle: Cadet development milestone
cards.notes: Look for Academy-published coverage or schedules to learn how this named dinner fits the cadet experience; do not assume public attendance.
cards.short_summary: Exemplar Dinner is one of the named milestones in the Academy’s official cadet journey.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Air Force Academy lists Exemplar Dinner among its official milestones.
cards.source_title: The Milestones of the Academy
cards.access_notes: This is a cadet-program milestone; attendance is governed by Academy procedures.

cards.title: Majors Night
cards.subtitle: Academic-choice milestone
cards.notes: Use current Academy academic resources to explore majors and treat this named event as a cadet milestone, not a general public open house.
cards.short_summary: Majors Night marks an academic decision point in the official Academy milestone sequence.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Air Force Academy lists Majors Night among its official milestones.
cards.source_title: The Milestones of the Academy
cards.access_notes: Availability and attendance are determined by current Academy schedules.

cards.title: Commitment Dinner
cards.subtitle: Cadet commitment milestone
cards.notes: Follow official Academy communications for the current context of this milestone and any applicable guest or installation-access procedures.
cards.short_summary: Commitment Dinner is a named step in the Academy’s official milestones.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Air Force Academy lists Commitment Dinner among its official milestones.
cards.source_title: The Milestones of the Academy
cards.access_notes: This is a cadet-focused event; public access is not asserted.

cards.title: National Character and Leadership Symposium
cards.subtitle: NCLS milestone
cards.notes: Check official NCLS communications for the current program and registration details; this recurring symposium is part of the Academy’s milestone framework.
cards.short_summary: NCLS is the Academy’s named character-and-leadership symposium milestone.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Air Force Academy lists NCLS among its official milestones.
cards.source_title: The Milestones of the Academy
cards.access_notes: Participation and any guest access depend on the current Academy program.

cards.title: Wing Open Boxing
cards.subtitle: Cadet Wing competition
cards.notes: Experience this through official coverage or authorized event information; the tournament is organized as a supervised Academy boxing competition for cadets.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Cadet Wing boxing tournament culminates in championship bouts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says Wing Open Boxing has run since 1958, with eligible cadets from all 40 squadrons trying out through inter-squadron competition.
cards.source_title: Wing Open Boxing
cards.access_notes: Cadet participation is through Academy-supervised programming; verify any spectator access with current Academy information.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at United States Air Force Academy, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative Friday-through-Sunday sequence using public Academy destinations, with access and schedule checks kept explicit.

cards.entity_name: General Bradley and Zita Hosmer Visitor Center
cards.title: Start at the Hosmer Visitor Center
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · outside the North Gate
cards.notes: Begin with the exhibits and visitor information, then use staff guidance to shape the rest of your on-base route.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission gateway for orientation and exhibits before entering the wider campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hosmer Visitor Center is outside the North Gate, requires no military ID or base access to enter, and is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: The General Bradley and Zita Hosmer Visitor Center
cards.access_notes: Official page lists daily 9 a.m.–5 p.m. hours and federal-holiday, Christmas Eve, and New Year’s Eve closures; free on-site parking.

cards.title: Take the Chapel Trail slowly
cards.subtitle: Friday · Hosmer Visitor Center to Cadet Area
cards.notes: Use the paved third-mile trail for the approach to the cadet area; pause at benches and allow extra time at altitude.
cards.short_summary: A short paved route linking the visitor center with the chapel and Honor Court area.
cards.evidence_claim: Chapel Trail is a 1/3-mile paved nature trail from the Visitor Center to the Cadet Chapel, Honor Court, and cadet viewing area, with benches along the way.
cards.source_title: Self-Guided Tour
cards.access_notes: The Academy advises visitors not acclimated to altitude to take breaks and drink water; limited-mobility visitors may need their own wheelchair and assistance.

cards.title: See the Cadet Chapel’s landmark form
cards.subtitle: Friday · base of Chapel Trail
cards.notes: View the 17-spire exterior from the designated route, and treat the current renovation enclosure as part of the site’s story.
cards.short_summary: The Academy’s all-faith chapel is currently closed for its long-term renovation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cadet Chapel has 17 spires rising 150 feet and is closed for necessary repairs with an estimated completion in 2028.
cards.source_title: Cadet Chapel
cards.access_notes: Interior access is unavailable during the renovation; remain on public routes and observe construction controls.

cards.title: Walk through Honor Court
cards.subtitle: Friday · beside Harmon Hall
cards.notes: Continue from the trail into the open court and spend a few minutes identifying the memorials and historical sculptures.
cards.short_summary: An open cadet-area court with the Harmon memorial and multiple donated sculptures.
cards.evidence_claim: Honor Court is adjacent to Harmon Hall and contains the Harmon memorial plus historical statues and sculptures, including memorials to Tuskegee Airmen and Women Airforce Service Pilots.
cards.source_title: Self-Guided Tour
cards.access_notes: Reach it by Chapel Trail or use the Planetarium parking area to bypass the trail; on-base access rules apply.

cards.title: If Friday aligns, watch Noon Meal Formation
cards.subtitle: Friday at 11:30 a.m. · Honor Court wall
cards.notes: Call the visitor center that morning, then watch from the Honor Court wall only if the weather-permitting formation is confirmed.
cards.short_summary: A documented Academy tradition: the Cadet Wing marches across the Terrazzo to lunch.
cards.evidence_claim: During the school year, the noon meal formation is scheduled Monday through Friday at 11:30 a.m.; guests may view it from the Honor Court wall, but it can be cancelled without notice.
cards.source_title: Noon Meal Formation
cards.access_notes: Not a weekend activity: it is scheduled on school-year weekdays only. Call 719-333-2025 on the morning of a visit to confirm.

cards.title: Catch a free public Planetarium show
cards.subtitle: Friday, if a posted showtime fits · 2120 Cadet Drive
cards.notes: Check the Academy’s current schedule, arrive about ten minutes early, and join the first-come seating line without reservations.
cards.short_summary: A 110-seat, 360-degree digital venue offering free public shows.
cards.evidence_claim: The Planetarium offers free public shows open to all on a first-come, first-served basis, without tickets or reservations.
cards.source_title: Planetarium
cards.access_notes: Consult the official weekly schedule before traveling; shows may change, and the Planetarium is closed on weekends, Graduation Day, and federal holidays.

cards.title: Reset at Arnold Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · west of the Cadet Area
cards.notes: Use the public social-center spaces to see the theater displays, then take a break before continuing to another outdoor stop.
cards.short_summary: A public-facing cadet social center with theater, food, coffee, meeting, and recreation spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Arnold Hall is the cadet wing’s social center and is open to the public except under base restrictions; it includes the theater, ballroom, food court, coffee shop, and recreational facilities.
cards.source_title: Arnold Hall
cards.access_notes: Public entry is subject to base restrictions. Food and coffee are available but are optional purchases.

cards.title: Pause at Athletic Overlook
cards.subtitle: Friday drive · Academy Drive
cards.notes: Use this designated roadside overlook for a broad view of the athletic fields, then continue only on public roads and signed areas.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided-tour stop overlooking the Academy’s athletic complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Athletic Overlook is the second overlook along Academy Drive and looks toward 57 athletic fields covering more than 140 acres.
cards.source_title: Self-Guided Tour
cards.access_notes: A drive-up overlook on the official self-guided route; access remains subject to installation entry requirements.

cards.title: Walk the Heritage Trail at Doolittle Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday daytime · 3116 Academy Drive
cards.notes: Follow the Heritage Trail across Challenge Bridge and stop at the Southeast Asia Pavilion and Memorial Wall before heading out.
cards.short_summary: Association of Graduates headquarters with outdoor Vietnam-era memorial exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Doolittle Hall is home to the Association of Graduates; its Heritage Trail includes Challenge Bridge, the Southeast Asia Pavilion, and Memorial Wall.
cards.source_title: Self-Guided Tour
cards.access_notes: Official self-guided tour lists parking; the gift shop is open to the public Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4 p.m., but purchases are optional.

cards.title: Make Saturday a Falcon Spur Trail walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday daylight · near the North Gate B-52 display
cards.notes: Choose the short out-and-back route, stay on the established trail, and use the B-52 parking area and trail amenities as directed.
cards.short_summary: An easy 1.4-mile trail beginning near the North Gate B-52 static display.
cards.evidence_claim: Falcon Spur Trail is an easy 1.4-mile out-and-back route that begins near the North Gate B-52 display; the Academy lists parking there plus restrooms, trash cans, and picnic tables.
cards.source_title: Hiking and Biking Trails
cards.access_notes: Use daylight and stay on the established path. The Academy requires dogs to be leashed and directs visitors to follow current base-entry instructions.

warnings: On-base destinations remain subject to Academy entry rules and operational restrictions. The Friday-only Noon Meal Formation and weekday Planetarium option are intentionally conditional rather than assumed weekend activities.
